mapper.select: SELECT ri.id, ri.receipt_id, ri.doc_id, ri.item_id, ri.material_id, ri.qty, ri.serial_nos, m.code AS material_code, m.name AS material_name, m.spec, m.unit, i.batch_no, tl.code AS to_location_code FROM wms_transfer_receipt_item ri JOIN wms_stock_doc_item i ON i.id = ri.item_id JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = ri.material_id LEFT JOIN wms_location tl ON tl.id = i.to_location_id WHERE ri.doc_id = #{docId} ORDER BY ri.receipt_id, ri.id
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO wms_transfer_receipt_item (receipt_id, doc_id, item_id, material_id, qty, serial_nos, create_time, update_time) VALUES
(#{i.receiptId}, #{i.docId}, #{i.itemId}, #{i.materialId}, #{i.qty}, #{i.serialNos}, NOW(), NOW())
